_comment: Example Claude Code PreToolUse wiring for test-protection-guard (the agentic-harness door). Replace the absolute path. The guard is advisory: it always returns an 'allow' decision and surfaces a flag in permissionDecisionReason + stderr. Enable it and point its log somewhere stable via environment variables exported in the session that launches the agent, e.g. TEST_PROTECTION_GUARD=on and TEST_PROTECTION_GUARD_LOG_DIR=$HOME/.agent/logs.
